paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
CUSTOMER SERVICE ASSISTANT (PART-TIME), Lakeside Garden Centre

We are looking for a friendly, reliable person to join our busy team.

Duties: greeting customers, answering questions about plants and products, operating the tills and restocking shelves.

Hours: 20 hours a week, including every second Saturday.

Pay: £11.50 per hour, plus a 20% staff discount on all products.

Requirements: previous retail experience is desirable but not essential, as full training will be given during the first two weeks. Applicants must be able to lift boxes weighing up to 15 kg. A basic knowledge of gardening is an advantage.

How to apply: please send your CV and a short covering letter to the manager, Ms Rita Fernandes, by 30 November. Interviews will be held in the week beginning 9 December and the successful candidate will start in January. Lakeside Garden Centre is an equal opportunities employer.

texts.title: Text B: Staff Handbook (extract), Leave and Absence

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text:
ANNUAL LEAVE: Full-time staff receive 25 days of paid holiday a year. Part-time staff receive holiday in proportion to the hours they work. Requests for leave must be given to your line manager at least four weeks in advance. No leave may be taken during the first two weeks of December or during Easter week, as these are our busiest periods.

SICKNESS: If you are unable to work because of illness, you must telephone your manager before the start of your shift. Text messages are not accepted. If you are absent for more than three days, you must provide a doctor's note. Sick pay is available only to staff who have completed six months' service.

TRAINING: All new staff must complete health and safety training within their first month.

UNIFORM: Two shirts and a fleece are provided free of charge. Additional items may be bought for £8 each.

MOBILE PHONES: Phones should be kept in staff lockers during working hours.
